settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Fully qualified domain name of the web console and API server, e.g. rustdesk.example.org
settings.rustdesk_host_helper: Host name or public IP address that RustDesk clients connect to. Leave empty to use the web console host name
settings.web_client_notice: The browser client connects with websockets. Browsers block unencrypted websockets from HTTPS pages, so the browser client needs a TLS proxy in front of these ports. See the README.
settings.client_setup_description: In the RustDesk client, open Settings, then Network, then ID/Relay server and enter these values.
settings.key_not_ready: The key is generated when the ID server starts for the first time. Reload this page in a few seconds.
settings.not_configured: Save the settings to start the RustDesk server. The values for the clients will appear here.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another application
settings.ban_threshold_helper: After this many failed logins within 5 minutes, the IP address is blocked for 30 minutes. 0 disables the block
settings.log_retention_days_helper: Login, connection and file transfer logs older than this are deleted every night. 0 keeps them forever
settings.admin_allowlist_helper: One IP address or network per line, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to allow access from anywhere. RustDesk clients can always log in
settings.invalid_number: Enter a whole number in the allowed range
settings.invalid_ip_network: {value} is not a valid IP address or network
